page_title: LEV 0-0 ATM | Levante v Atletico Madrid 31/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Here comes a substitution. Tai Abed (Levante) is brought on as a substitute for Ivan Romero.

88' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Levante are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dela (Levante) was quite harsh and Victor Garcia didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
82' The attendance for today's match is 20573.
82' Dela (Levante) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
80' Koke (Atl. Madrid) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Mathew Ryan comes off the line to clear the ball away.
76' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

76' Dela (Levante) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would probably have ended up in the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak pulls off a decent save to thwart him. Now Levante have a corner.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Paco Cortes (Levante) is coming onto the pitch as Kareem Tunde cannot continue after picking up an injury.
75' Luis Castro prepares a substitution. Carlos Alvarez is replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante).
73' Substitution. Nicolas Gonzalez makes way for Jano Monserrate (Atl. Madrid).
72' Manu Sanchez (Levante) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
70' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) sends it out of play.

70' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) jumps high inside the box to head the rebound towards the roof of the net, but Mathew Ryan pulls off an amazing reflex save to keep the ball out of the net. Nice goalkeeping skill!
69' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
69' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
68' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
66' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
65' A cross from a corner kick by Atl. Madrid is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

64' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the right side of the goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Mathew Ryan. It will be a corner kick for Atl. Madrid.
62' Atl. Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
59' We are about to witness a substitution. Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) is replacing Iker Losada.
59' Substitution. Marcos Llorente leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid).
58' Luis Castro isn't happy on the touchline after referee Victor Garcia shows him a yellow card.
58' Marc Pubill (Atl. Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Thiago Almada.
56' Levante fail to score from a corner as Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid) leaps to collect the ball.
53' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
52' Ivan Romero (Levante) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The linesman makes the right call and Levante will have a corner.

50' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Victor Garcia blows his whistle for an infringement. Atl. Madrid win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
49' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) as he is replaced by Koke.
46' Half-time substitution. Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) will not participate anymore and David Hancko is coming on.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Victor Garcia who sees an offensive foul.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
43' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the left post.
42' Levante are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
40' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
35' A long pass, executed by Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
31' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Dela (Levante). Victor Garcia saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
29' Matias Moreno (Levante) looks very unsteady on his feet after that head injury. Safety first, so he’s coming off and Luis Castro has decided that Manu Sanchez is the man to take his place.
29' The linesman raises his flag. Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged offside.
27' It looks like Alexander Sorloth may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Diego Simeone replaces him with Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid).
24' The game is interrupted. Matias Moreno (Levante) suffers a horrific injury!
24' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Levante.
21' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Victor Garcia had an easy-decision to make.
19' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
19' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) will take a corner kick.

19' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Atl. Madrid will take a corner kick.
17' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
17' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Mathew Ryan comes off the line to clear the ball away.
10' Atl. Madrid enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
10' Victor Garcia blows his whistle after Johnny Cardoso (Atl. Madrid) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
8' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
6' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
2' The corner from Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by the defence.
2' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
2' There's an opportunity for Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Atl. Madrid will have the kick-off.
Victor Garcia will officiate today.
